## Description

Briefly describe the changes, new squad templates, or framework additions included in this pull request.

---

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🌟 New bot team template (`templates/*.md` and `templates/schemas/*.yaml`)
- [ ] 🛠️ CLI improvement / export target (`init-team.py`)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation enhancement (`docs/*` or `README.md`)
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (broken link, typo, schema defect)
- [ ] 🛡️ CI / workflow enhancement

## Quality Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the repository's [Production Standard](docs/PRODUCTION_STANDARD.md).
- [ ] If adding or editing a template, I ran `python3 init-team.py --validate` and it exited with `0`.
- [ ] If adding a new template, both the Markdown spec and YAML schema are included.
- [ ] Any new links added to `README.md` have been verified and are active.
- [ ] Commit messages follow the conventional format (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:`).
